# Pools

A pool names one runtime ([POOL-R1](../../spec/capabilities/pools/warm-pools.md#pool-r1)). Placement is described on [the placement page](../../spec/components/placement.md). The [resource][podclaim] is defined on its interface page.

The old reference is [§4.6](../../spec/04_system-components.md#46-pod-lifecycle-controllers), and [the spec root](../../spec/) holds the pages.

[podclaim]: ../../spec/interfaces/kubernetes/podclaim.md#custom-resource-podclaim
